summary.text: ARTISTFELLESSKAPET AS is a private limited company registered in Stavanger, founded 2023-06-21. ARTISTFELLESSKAPET AS organiserer og omsetter tjenester knyttet til utøvende artister, musikere og musikkprodusenter, og tilbyr fullverdig ansettelse for selvstendige i musikkbransjen. It was previously named EMPLOY WHITELABEL 20230621 AS until 2024-05-04. Its main industry code is 90.201: performing arts activities in music. The register shows 98 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 45 009 148 NOK and the annual result was 218 572 NOK; operating income was up from 8 323 932 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 9 690 NOK in 2024 to 218 572 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 102 708 NOK in 2024 to 321 673 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is artistfellesskapet.no. The registered employee count went from 93 on 2025-11-13 to 98 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
